kralcash.title: KralCash
kralcash.subtitle: Web-based POS & business management SaaS
kralcash.description: I independently designed, developed and deployed KralCash, a web-based SaaS bringing checkout and day-to-day business management into one bilingual interface. From the Angular frontend to the Spring Boot backend and Google Cloud deployment, I built the project end to end.
kralcash.engineering: REST APIs connect the frontend to a PostgreSQL-backed service, with transactional consistency and idempotency to keep operations reliable. Automated tests support the application, deployed in Docker containers on Google Cloud.

altenIntern.title: Software Engineering Intern · Full-stack & DevOps
altenIntern.description: Participation to the development of an interactive web application in the form of a multiplayer game, designed to simulate logistical scenarios in an educational and engaging manner. Developed in fullstack with Java (Spring Boot), Angular, PostgreSQL and Liquibase for the database. Implementation of CI/CD pipelines with Azure DevOps, versioning with Git, and work in Agile.

projects.title: Completed Projects

wolfIt.name: WolfIt AI Game
wolfIt.description: Developed a web platform for the social deduction game Werewolf, allowing users to play against AI opponents. Figma was used for UI design, React.js for the front-end, PHP for the back-end, and Python for AI algorithm development. (24H DU CODE 2024)

highlights.ai: Python algorithms for AI-controlled Werewolf opponents.
highlights.web: React interface and PHP backend, designed with Figma.

enssimasso.name: 5th Year Project: ENSSIMASSO
enssimasso.description: Developed a website consolidating all school associations and clubs, enabling students to register, interact with associations, participate in a forum, and view events.

highlights.community: Association registration, student forum and events.
highlights.stack: React and Spring Boot with MySQL and Azure in the stack.

commUni.name: University Communication System
commUni.description: Built a web platform to facilitate communication between students and faculty, using Figma for interface design, React.js for a dynamic front-end, PHP for the back-end, and MySQL for database management. (ENSIM 2023-2024)

highlights.communication: A shared web platform for students and faculty.
highlights.data: Dynamic React interface with PHP and MySQL.

footPourTous.name: FootPourTous Mobile App
footPourTous.description: Developed an Android app for booking management at a sports center. The project used Kotlin for mobile development and Firebase for real-time data and user management. (ENSIM 2023-2024)

highlights.mobile: Sports-centre booking flows built in Kotlin.
highlights.realtime: Real-time reservations and user management with Firebase.

gameVR.name: VR Game
gameVR.description: Created an immersive virtual reality game where the player is an extraterrestrial cosmic guardian. The project used Unity for the game engine, Blender for 3D modeling, Git for version control, C for scripting, and Mixamo for character animations. (ENSIM 2023-2024)

highlights.immersive: An immersive Unity experience with a cosmic guardian character.
highlights.assets: 3D assets and character animation using Blender and Mixamo.
